# gitea_actions_runner_registration_token (Data Source)

Creates and returns an Actions runner registration token for the selected scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_actions_runner_registration_token" "example" {
  scope = "org"
  org   = "my-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) The Actions scope: `admin`, `user`, `org`, or `repo`.

### Optional

- `org` (String) The organisation name when `scope = "org"`.
- `repository` (String) The repository name when `scope = "repo"`.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner when `scope = "repo"`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The runner registration token.
